name: Requests read from a declared source, once
purpose: An adapter hands over each waiting request once, skips what is not a request and leaves the rest of the source alone.
record: Conformance cases written here over a folder of queued requests. A second consumer's adapter scored by that consumer's code is needed to measure how little code a new source takes.
disadvantages: One adapter shape (a folder of files); a chat or a task list is a researched candidate with no arm yet.
